other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Delhi
Applicant must belong to Minority or Persons with Disability groups
Admission must be secured in a recognized government/technical institution that has offered the course for at least three years and is recognized by UGC, AICTE or other appropriate authorities
Course duration must not exceed 5 years
Borrower must not engage in any unlawful activity or take additional financial liabilities during the loan tenure
Borrower must seek suitable employment after completing the course and provide full employment and income details to DSFDC
benefits_summary: Need‑based loan up to ₹7.5 lakh for studies in India and up to ₹15 lakh for studies abroad, with repayment up to 10 years after commencement.
